title: Count Ways To Climb
description:
## Task

A staircase has `n` steps. Each move climbs either 1 or 2 steps. Count the distinct sequences of moves that reach the top exactly.

## Input

- `n` — the number of steps, zero or more.

## Output

An integer: the number of distinct ways to climb. With no steps there is exactly one way: making no moves.

## Example

```python
count_ways(6)  # returns 13
count_ways(7)  # returns 21
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ `n` ≤ 90
